selectionNotes: Select Vernazza et al. (2021) ADAM model5914 over older convex1086. The VLT/SPHERE imaging study reports volume-equivalent141 ±2 km, agreeing with the selected archive diameter and raw volume141.094. MPCD is a promising refinement documented in the paper; its linked LAM release could not be retrieved during this survey. The mounted source is the pinned ADAM mesh, not an unverified MPCD or reflectance product.
